legend: A new set of desks just arrived, and it's about time! Things were getting quite cramped in the office. You've been put in charge of creating a new seating chart for the engineers. The desks are numbered, and you sent out a survey to the engineering team asking each engineer the number of the desk they currently sit at, and the number of the desk they would like to sit at (which may be the same as their current desk). Each engineer must either remain where they sit, or move to the desired seat they indicated in the survey. No two engineers currently sit at the same desk, nor may any two engineers sit at the same desk in the new seating arrangement.
How many seating arrangements can you create that meet the specified requirements? The answer may be very large, so compute it modulo 1000000007 = 109 + 7.
input: Input will begin with a line containing N (1 ≤ N ≤ 100000), the number of engineers.

N lines follow, each containing exactly two integers. The i-th line contains the number of the current desk of the i-th engineer and the number of the desk the i-th engineer wants to move to. Desks are numbered from 1 to 2·N. It is guaranteed that no two engineers sit at the same desk.
output: Print the number of possible assignments, modulo 1000000007 = 109 + 7.

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含 N（1 ≤ N ≤ 100000），表示工程师的数量。
接下来有 N 行，每行恰好包含两个整数。第 i 行包含第 i 名工程师当前所在办公桌的编号，以及第 i 名工程师想要移动到的办公桌编号。办公桌的编号从 1 到 2·N。保证没有两名工程师坐在同一张办公桌旁。

output.ai: 输出可能的分配方案数，结果对 1000000007 = 109 + 7 取模。

note.ai: 第一个样例中的可能分配如下：

legend.ai: 一批新的办公桌刚刚送到，真是时候！办公室已经变得相当拥挤。你负责为工程师制定新的座位安排。办公桌都有编号，你向工程团队发起了一项调查，询问每位工程师当前所坐的办公桌编号，以及他们希望坐的办公桌编号（可能与当前办公桌相同）。每位工程师必须留在当前座位，或移动到他们在调查中指定的目标座位。当前没有两名工程师坐在同一张办公桌旁，新的座位安排中也不能有两名工程师坐在同一张办公桌旁。
你可以创建多少种满足指定要求的座位安排？答案可能非常大，因此请计算其对 1000000007 = 109 + 7 取模的结果。
